_README: Hand review of the shop classifier's verdicts. commerce.json stays exactly what the model returned; this file records where a hand check disagreed and why, so both are auditable. Applied on top of commerce.json by build-site.ts. Added only after reading the site.
_method: Seeded sample, 40 from each side (seed 31337), judged against the rule committed in classify-shops.ts: a shop sells goods or services to the public and a visitor can start a purchase; news, reference, social, government, sport, banking and free tools are not shops even when they sell a subscription. 6 of 40 wrongly tagged shop, 4 of 40 wrongly tagged not-shop.

flickr.com.reason: Photo hosting and community. A Pro subscription does not make a social site a shop; the rule excludes a free tool even when it sells one.

flightaware.com.reason: Flight tracking — reference. Sells subscriptions; primary purpose is looking things up.

marinetraffic.com.reason: Ship tracking — reference, same shape as flightaware.com.

tradingview.com.reason: Charts and market data — reference and social. Subscriptions do not change the primary purpose.

pittsburghpanthers.com.reason: Official athletics website. The rule names sport as not-shop; a team store on a subdomain is not this site's purpose.

ultimate-guitar.com.reason: Chords and tabs catalogue — reference, with a Pro subscription.

newgrounds.com.reason: Free games and animation portal with a supporter subscription — a free tool, which the rule excludes explicitly.

divar.ir.reason: Iran's largest classifieds marketplace — buying and selling goods. The rule names a marketplace, and leboncoin.fr and publi24.ro were tagged shop for exactly this.

farpost.ru.reason: Russian classifieds marketplace, same shape as leboncoin.fr.

udio.com.reason: AI music generation sold self-serve on paid plans — software sold self-serve, which the rule names.

pinecone.io.reason: Vector database sold self-serve on paid tiers — software sold self-serve.
